name: Kenshin
subtitle: Dragon of Echigo
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Uesugi Kenshin stands among the ranks of great samurai and military leaders along with Oda Nobunaga and Takeda Shingen, and is a highly respected administrator as well. Kenshin would prefer to govern his own province in peace, but feels compelled to thwart the ambitions of both those men, even if that means reluctantly ruling the non-divine regions of Izumo himself.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%
Awaken the ability: Fight with the Sword

skills.name: Fight with the Sword
skills.description: Attack all enemy (8%HP+120%ATK) then decrease each target’s Turn Meter by 10%. If a target is under [DEF Down], will also decrease their Divinity by 10%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Will now Steal the Divinity instead.

skills.name: Honour Bound
skills.description: Attack all enemies (15%HP+200%ATK) which ignores [mechanic:intercept] and [Protect]. If the target is under a [mechanic:shield] will remove the 50% of the [mechanic:shield] before attacking. If the target is under [mechanic:barrier], will steal 25% before attacking.

skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.description: Increase this hero’s turn meter by 10% when joining an attack or retaliating.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the ally is from Izumo, will use the Core Abilty instead.
